jornalNaLinha.dica: Published issues appear on the Timeline on the issue's date (Newspapers filter). For the GM, scheduled issues appear under "Next 30 days".

Jornal.LerDica: Open the issue as a newspaper, to read
Jornal.LerConvite: Open the issue as a full newspaper to read at ease.
Jornal.LerSalvoAviso: Reading shows the saved version. Save to see your latest changes.
Jornal.SemAcesso: You don't have access to this.
Jornal.NotaEdicao: GM note about the issue (only you see it)
Jornal.ApresentarDica: Open on the screens of connected players who can read it
Jornal.ArquivarDica: Moves to the archive; readers can still read it
Jornal.DespublicarDica: Back to draft (players stop seeing it)
Jornal.DespublicarPergunta: Issue No. {n} goes back to draft and players stop seeing it. Nothing is deleted.
Jornal.ApagarPergunta: Permanently delete issue No. {n} ({titulo})? To hide it from players without deleting, use Unpublish or Archive.
Jornal.VerComoJogadorDica: Hide what only you see (truthfulness and notes) to check the issue as players see it
Jornal.NenhumJornalGM: No newspapers yet. Create the first one with +.
Jornal.NenhumJornal: No newspaper circulates to you yet.
Jornal.CriarAgora: There are no newspapers yet. Create one now?
Jornal.NaoCircula: This newspaper doesn't circulate to any player yet (the eye at the top of the newspaper page). Once published, the issue is only visible to you until you allow it.
Jornal.AvisarChat: Announce in chat (only readers receive it)
Jornal.SemCalendario: Without a world calendar you can't schedule: publish whenever you like.
Jornal.PublicarSozinha: Publish automatically when the day comes (off: only notify you)
Jornal.HojeE: Today is {hoje}. A day already past publishes right away.
Jornal.DataNaoExiste: That date doesn't exist in this calendar.
Jornal.ChegouData: Issue No. {n} of {jornal} reached its publication date. Publish whenever you like (Newspapers and News tab).
Jornal.NinguemConectado: No connected player can read this issue (is it published, and does the newspaper circulate to them?).

Exemplo.nome: The Voice of the Four Roads
Exemplo.subtitulo: News, rumors and stories from all the known world
Exemplo.manchete: Mysterious flames light up the northern skies
Exemplo.rodape: Printed at 12 Typesetters' Street · Price: 2 cp
Exemplo.nota: What is actually true, who planted the story...

Jornal.QuemLeDica: Readers are whoever can see this page in Journal da Mesa (the eye at the top of the page). Published issues follow that permission.
Jornal.SalvarNaoPublica: Saving never publishes: the issue's state only changes through its buttons.
Jornal.SemVinculos: No links. Use Link or drag an NPC, place, quest, event or actor here. NPCs, places and actors with an image come in with their photo (the camera turns it on and off).
Jornal.UuidInvalido: That document can't be linked (use a journal, page, actor or item from this world).
Jornal.NadaParaLigar: Nothing in the world to link yet.
Jornal.TirarFoto: Remove the photo from the story
Jornal.MostrarFoto: Show the photo in the story
Jornal.CapaIdentidade: Name, logo, style and color belong to the newspaper: change them under Identity, on the newspaper page.
Jornal.ConferirDica: Check the issue as players will see it in Preview. Saving doesn't publish: publish with the issue's buttons, on the newspaper page.

Ajuda.capa: This issue's number and date, and who signs as editor.
Ajuda.manchete: The main story: it appears at the top of the first page, with big letters and the main image.
Ajuda.noticia: The first two appear next to the headline; the next ones go to "Other news" and to the following pages.
Ajuda.rumor: Short rumors going around. One or two sentences are enough.
Ajuda.classificado: Short ads: shops, services, wanted, hiring.
Ajuda.final: Footer printed at the end of the newspaper and a note only for you.
Ajuda.previa: This is how players will see this issue (includes what isn't saved yet).

Vazio.noticia: No news yet. Start with the most important one after the headline.
Vazio.rumor: No rumors yet. E.g.: "They say the old bridge is haunted."
Vazio.aviso: No notices yet. E.g.: "50 gp reward for catching the Raven."
Vazio.classificado: No ads yet. E.g.: "The Safe Harbor tavern: clean rooms."

Jornal.QuemAparece: Who or what appears in this story
Jornal.VincularLongo: Link a person, place or event
Jornal.SegredoDica: truthfulness and note (players never see it)

Json.Colar: Paste the JSON here (from an exported file)
Json.DataInvalida: the JSON date doesn't exist in this calendar (today's date was used)
Json.ExportarDica: Download this issue as JSON (works as a template for the next ones)
Json.ImportadoAqui: Content imported into this issue. Check it and save.
Json.ImportarAquiDica: The JSON content replaces this issue's (number and date stay if the JSON doesn't have them). Nothing is saved until you save.
Json.ImportarDica: Creates a new issue (draft) for each issue in the exported JSON.
Json.NovaAPartirDica: New issue from this one (copies the content as a draft)
Json.Grande: The text is too large to import (limit: {n} MB).
Json.MuitasEdicoes: Too many issues in one JSON (limit: {n} at a time).
Json.FormatoOutro: the format "{formato}" is not a Journal da Mesa issue; imported what was recognized
Json.VersaoNova: the JSON uses version {v} of the format, newer than this one; imported what was recognized
Json.MateriasCortadas: the issue had {total} stories; imported the first {n} (the limit)
Json.NumeroRepetido: this newspaper already has an issue no. {n}
Json.SegredosFalhou: issue no. {n} was created, but the truth labels and GM notes were not saved
Json.SoPrimeira: the JSON had {n} issues; only the first goes here (use Import issue on the newspaper page to create all of them)
